correctness.rationale: The explicit product-ring example has a strong idempotent-generated multiplicative set and a non-strong power-generated set, while their localizations are abstractly isomorphic by countable-product absorption. The intersection and spectral calculations independently separate the two cases, and the R-algebra repair follows from the localization universal property.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source theorem and proof were inspected and targeted searches found no prior correction or equivalent explicit counterexample. General map-compatible localization language is standard and is not claimed as new; the elementary nature of the distinction and the incompletely inspected superseded predecessor remain residual risks.

value.rationale: The result corrects a literal clause in the main structural characterization of a recent preprint and demonstrates that the missing map compatibility is mathematically essential rather than cosmetic.
